$Comment: Old Jack's Favor: the name, picture and limits of the game's reputation group of the same id
Gear names the stat whose Max equipped items add on top of what a player has earned; the Jack
Helm and the Burning Jack Helm add to it, which helps a player toward each rank on the way up.
Cap is the most favor earning can reach: Exalted's floor, so Jack's Own is as far as it goes,
and gear worn there has no rank left to reach. Ranks renames the library's ranks for Old Jack
alone; a rank left out keeps the library's name. Order places him on the Reputation page. Favor
comes from the Reputation rewards on his quests and board contracts and from his daily board
line. Earn lists those ways, one lang key a line, for the How to earn block on the Reputation
